title: The workshop
text: The workshop door is open, and {legacy.parent} is waiting: there is a place at the bench for you, as an apprentice, if you want it.

choices.label: Take the apprenticeship
choices.text: Learn the family trade, tool by tool.

effects.text: You tie on the apron. The tools are heavier than they looked.

choices.label: Decline
choices.text: The workshop is not your life.

effects.text: You turn the apprenticeship down. The bench stays empty.
